articles.image_title: Holocaust-Ausstellung in Berlin: Anna Haag (geb. Schaich) schrieb ab 1940 regelmäßig Tagebuch. Sie analysierte die NS-Propaganda und die Stimmung in der Bevölkerung und trug Details über Verbrechen zusammen. Immer wieder haderte sie damit, so viel zu wissen und doch nichts dagegen tun zu können, weil sie das selbst in Gefahr bringen könnte. Aus Angst vor Denunziation versteckte sie ihr Tagebuch im Kohlenkeller.

articles.image_title: Öl- und Gasheizungen: Modern Radiator in Neon Light Representing Energy Transition and Sustainable Resource Challenges - Stock-Fotografie Conceptual image of a white radiator presented in a futuristic setting with purple and blue neon lighting. This studio shot uses a manufactured object to symbolize the global energy crisis and the critical need for an energy transition in modern society. The vibrant color gradient and high contrast shadows emphasize the complexity of environmental issues such as the carbon footprint and fossil fuel dependency. As a staple of household equipment, the radiator becomes a conceptual symbol for the rising cost of living, energy efficient technology, and the financial stress of home ownership. This digitally generated image explores themes of scarcity, the need for sustainable resources, and the technical innovation required for fuel and power generation. The minimalist composition invites contemplation on the domestic economy, budget planning, and the way forward for social issues related to global warming and resource management within a domestic room.
